Strategy / funnel / pipeline

A clear path from first contact to customer.

Connect your audience, offer, conversion journey, and sales process. We structure funnels and pipelines around what the customer needs next and how your team will recognize useful progress.

Shape this service ↗Open the capability explorer →
Level 2Choose a capability

The constraint we solve.

Growth becomes hard to manage when campaigns, forms, sales stages, and reporting use different definitions. A funnel needs a coherent offer, a relevant next step, reliable handoffs, and a way to distinguish interest from qualified demand.

Questions we begin with

  • Where does a qualified buyer lose clarity or momentum today?
  • Which stages and decisions need a person, an automated rule, or better evidence?
  • What will your team count as a valid lead, qualified opportunity, and successful customer outcome?

Who it can support

  • B2B teams building a focused acquisition and sales motion.
  • Service businesses connecting campaign enquiries to a repeatable commercial process.
  • Product teams refining an existing journey across regions or customer segments.

Market research and account intelligence

Level 4Inspect the detail

Turn a broad market into a usable account strategy. We combine permitted external evidence, existing customer knowledge, and human judgment to define the segments, signals, and questions worth investigating.

Where it is useful

  • Research companies in a defined region and category before launching a focused outbound campaign.
  • Compare permitted public product and market information to find positioning questions worth testing.
  • Refresh existing CRM accounts and separate useful buying signals from incomplete or conflicting records.
  • An ideal customer profile with segment criteria, buying roles, exclusions, and an evidence trail.
  • A researched account dataset with agreed fields, deduplication rules, source dates, and confidence notes.
  • A prioritized account map and messaging hypotheses that your sales team can assess.

Conversion journeys and funnel architecture

Level 4Inspect the detail

Give every stage of the buying journey a clear purpose. We design acquisition, landing, lead capture, qualification, nurture, and conversion as a connected system with an explicit next step.

Where it is useful

  • Build a paid-campaign landing journey that routes suitable enquiries to the right next step.
  • Clarify a complex B2B buying process with different journeys for education, evaluation, and purchase.
  • Find and prioritize friction between a marketing click, lead capture, and the first sales conversation.
  • A journey map with entry channels, conversion events, qualification criteria, and ownership at each stage.
  • Landing-page wireframes, message hierarchy, form requirements, and follow-up paths for the agreed audience.
  • An event and experiment plan connecting traffic, valid leads, qualified demand, and customer outcomes.

Sales pipeline and lifecycle handoffs

Level 4Inspect the detail

Make the route from a promising account to a customer visible. We define stages, ownership, service expectations, and operating rules so marketing and sales work from the same definitions.

Where it is useful

  • Route qualified campaign enquiries to an available owner with a visible next action.
  • Coordinate approved outbound activity with CRM opportunity stages and sales feedback.
  • Clean up a fragmented pipeline so lost, stalled, and active opportunities can be distinguished.
  • A CRM stage model with entry and exit rules, required fields, ownership, and exception paths.
  • Routing, follow-up, and lifecycle workflows with approved communication rules and escalation points.
  • A pipeline scorecard and operating guide for review, cleanup, and day-to-day accountability.

01

Before implementation

  • Your business goal, offer, audience, target regions, and current sales process.
  • Access to existing website, CRM, campaign, and reporting evidence where available.
  • Named marketing and sales owners, approved communication rules, and scope constraints.
Can we begin with one focused capability?

Yes. Discovery identifies a useful scope with clear inputs, deliverables, owners, and acceptance checks. A broader engagement can connect additional capabilities once the first workflow and its dependencies are understood.

Will you work with our existing tools?

We review the existing stack before selecting or replacing a platform. Connections depend on the provider APIs, account plans, permissions, licensing, data quality, and the project scope; they are validated before being promised as part of delivery.

How do human expertise and AI work together?

Specialists own strategy, design, architecture, approved communication, and final business decisions. AI can assist bounded preparation and repeated tasks. Generated work is evaluated against representative examples and reviewed at the agreed points; uncertain cases have a named owner.
